acceptance: Capability-before-Design: nine contract candidates grounded in immutable Stage1-4/Consumer evidence; 9 controlled false acceptances observed. Freeze inventory before any implementation. 6 NORMALIZE, 2 CLARIFY, 1 KEEP. No schema/version expansion, second authority/store, migration or historical rewrite.

Structured directory authority: resolve existing immutable Design ref; accepted JSON with matching project/basis revision and exact existing directory declaration fields takes priority. Human explanation grants no directory authority. Preserve only uniquely interpretable narrow historical Markdown table, matching path/purpose/content_type/authority_type; ambiguous/rejected/fenced/conflicting tables fail closed.

SHA/dual baseline: retain existing local candidate, review_target_revision, expected_base_sha, expected_remote_head_sha, verified_baseline_sha and publication_sha meanings. Remove publication wildcard; only direct expected-W equality or explicit expected-W/bound-remote-P tuple. Native verify_work_publication remains actual Git/live authority. Reject conflicting implementation_sha copies.

PRE: compare exact immutable WU ref, scope, state/project/repository/remote bindings and Result identity/revision/completion. Legacy minimal pure helper records may omit paired optional fields only when both inputs are equally unbound; genuine durable entry remains full schema validated. Exact revision types must be nonnegative integer, never bool/None for executable authority.

Durable PRE/reference: optional exact immutable request/result locator pair in existing incremental API, bound into process-local attestation. v2.13 execution inputs require this pair; exact committed bytes must equal named local bytes; wrong identity/bytes/revision fail closed. Existing legacy path mode remains supported and explicitly classified; no pathname/latest guessing or new artifacts.

Completion: compose existing schema semantics in native completion helper, preserving legitimate zero-test management. Only implementer IMPLEMENTATION_RESULT can project execution ALREADY_COMPLETE. PASS Result, review PASS, published W and verified P remain distinct from explicit same-WU COMPLETE authority.

FIX: require REVIEW_FINDING at lifecycle entry, existing exact IDs/identity/finding subset/decision/basis. Normalize request-bound rereview via optional existing REVIEW_REQUEST; legacy direct FIX response still reads. Exact-W finalizer may consume a real FIX plus durable unique Finding/decision and request-bound independent POST using existing fields, without manufacturing a duplicate EXECUTION/PRE chain. Preserve immutable original Finding/evidence.

WU compatibility: schema_version stays 1; basis_state_revision is STATE authority, ref.sha is immutable WU revision. No new WU revision counter; stale exact references denied. Read old/new immutable JSON through existing resolver with explicit LEGACY_VALID/CURRENT_VALID/STALE_OR_AMBIGUOUS classification and duplicate-key rejection. New Instruction canonicality is keyed to existing framework_version >=2.13.0; raw legacy bytes never rewritten.

Temporal KEEP: observed event times may explain created/reviewed/published/verified/closed only; no new timestamp fields or ordering subsystem and never substitute for SHA/revision. Fingerprint KEEP implementation: raw bytes include CRLF/encoding distinctions; canonical generation UTF8/no BOM/LF sorted compact JSON plus newline. Document exact existing input/invalidation scope; no global hashing subsystem.

Tests: one small regression file for observed core false acceptances and old/current normal paths; register its exact existing validation owner. Existing schemas unchanged. Focused/affected tests, real Consumer new/historical/mixed paths, controlled labelled stale/SHA/identity/WU/correlation/FIX/PASS/bytes/CRLF negatives, then exactly one release full suite. Preserve failed output and rerun only changed/affected inputs.

Execution inline with genuine separate-context PRE/POST; explicit user end-to-end Stage5 authorization includes scoped materialization, normal push, v2.13.0 tag/Release and same-WU durable closure. No force push, connector, automation, bootstrap/workspace refactor or Stage6 work. Stop after verified release and STATE sync.

Real Consumer only acceptance/issue17-stage5-contract-normalization from completed Stage4 acceptance branch. No business main or old acceptance branch mutation. A bounded intentionally failing acceptance evidence candidate may generate a genuine independent Finding, then user-authorized typed FIX/PRE/rereview using same WU; label controlled probe rather than claiming a business defect. New projected v2.13 native code validates all paths; immutable historical hashes compared before/after.

Observable before/after counts use this frozen inventory/static checks/executed controlled probes only. Historical retries/steps without reliable records are NOT_OBSERVABLE. Reviewer audits evidence justification, exact scope, schema inflation, single machine authority, old/new classification and Stage1-4 preservation.
